description: This file defines a Catalyst controller class for handling recipe import functionality, including actions for initializing import, previewing import options, and submitting import data.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Recipe::Import
classes.description: A Catalyst controller class managing recipe import workflows, including actions for initializing import, previewing, and submitting imported recipes.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Chained action that initializes the import process by loading the recipe and setting up the importer object.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Handles the preview step of the import, preparing data such as article units, recipe names, and related URLs for display.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Processes the submitted import form, validates data, and performs the import operation, then redirects to the recipe edit page.
